messages:
nina-cs: FYI onboarding check: Volt Labs is getting intermittent 429s right when their CI spins up multiple playwright workers. They use our browser SDK with ephemeral tokens issued by their auth service. Pasting short log captures below.

rob-cs: Can you confirm whether the 429s are happening on /sessions/handshake (preflight) or on /responses/generate?

nina-cs: Mostly handshake/preflight and a few short streaming requests. Sample header: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests`
Retry-After: 1
X-RateLimit-Limit: 180
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2765007905

eli-eng: Sounds like parallel preflight fanout. If each worker requests a fresh ephemeral token then immediately calls preflight, the per-account per-second window gets exhausted. Do they reuse tokens across workers?

nina-cs: Customer says their proxy creates a token per worker. They thought per-tab/session isolation required unique tokens.

eli-eng: Short-term fixes: 1) Have the proxy reuse ephemeral tokens for a short session window (recommended 60s) 2) Throttle client-side preflight concurrency (<=8) 3) Honor Retry-After and apply exponential jittered backoff on 429. Example SDK stub (browser):
```js
const r = new RedwoodBrowser({
  preflightConcurrency: 8,
  preflightRetry: { baseMs: 250, capMs: 2000, jitter: true }
});
```

rob-cs: Also recommend server-side session broker: mint one ephemeral per CI job and share with workers instead of one per worker. That prevents handshake storm while keeping short TTLs for security.

ops-bot: Note created: CS-7602 "Volt Labs onboarding - ephemeral token guidance" assigned to docs-triage.

eli-eng: We're going to instrument a quick account-level smoothing gate: if handshake rate > 50/s for an account, we'll apply short queuing for additional preflights. Filed ENG-4120 for a lightweight throttle config.

nina-cs: Shared the guidance with Volt Labs. They changed their proxy to reuse tokens for 90s and limited worker parallelism to 6. Their error rate dropped significantly in our monitor.

support-bot: Customer feedback logged: docs unclear about ephemeral token reuse semantics. Ticket #CS-7602 updated with customer quote.

rob-cs: Follow-ups for CS team: 1) Run a quick onboarding playbook update 2) Offer a short-run pairing to help them set up token reuse in CI 3) Monitor for 48h for any relapse.

nina-cs: Done. I'll loop in Solutions for a quick pairing session tomorrow. Thanks everyone :rocket:
